Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Awning: Shop awning (toldo) over a 2 m bay: striped canvas on a gentle convex curve, scalloped valance, iron arms and
front bar. The canvas slot (ENV_Canvas_*) carries the stripes; one texture tile across the bay = 4 stripes.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Balcony_Iron: Shallow stone-slab balcony with a wrought-iron railing and two iron brackets (balconera).
Slab on the kit MI_RockTrim slab band; ironwork is owned flat iron.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Bench_Street: Municipal street bench: cast-iron ends, timber slats (kit MI_WoodTrim dark band), faces +z.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Bicycle: Ordinary town bicycle, 1.7 m, wheels in the y-z plane (length along z); frame paint slot ENV_Paint_Red.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Bin_Street: Rustic litter bin: ring of dark timber slats (kit MI_WoodTrim dark band) bound by two iron hoops, iron rim,
dark liner inside. Free-standing, 0.8 m.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Boat_Small: Small inshore fishing boat (lancha), 5.6 m, bow towards +z, waterline at y = 0. Hull paint slot
ENV_Paint_Blue with a white sheer strake and a small wheelhouse.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Bollard_Mooring: Cast-iron mooring bollard (noray) for the quay coping: base plate, waisted body, mushroom cap.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Bollard_Street: Cast-iron street bollard (pilona), 0.95 m: moulded foot, slightly tapering body, collar and domed cap.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Box_Cardboard: Cardboard delivery box (0.5 x 0.4 x 0.35 m).

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Bridge_Arch: Stone arch under a casco bridge, as a 1 m wide slice along z that the district builder scales to the deck
width and along x to the span: segmental arch (span 10 m, springing 3.4 m below the deck, crown 0.6 m below it),
a ring of dressed voussoirs on both faces, rubble spandrels up to a moulded string course, rubble soffit.
Deck top at y = 0 (the builder lays the paved deck on it).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Buoy: Orange mooring/fishing buoy (floats on y = 0).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Cable_Run_2m: Surface-fixed service cable (2 m along the facade) with clips — added long after the building.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Cafe_Chair: Aluminium terrace chair (faces +z).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Cafe_Table: Round aluminium bar-terrace table (0.7 m).

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Clothesline: Window clothesline (tendedero): two iron brackets 0.55 m out from the wall, two lines, hanging clothes
in several colours. Mounted under an upper-floor window (origin on the wall face at bracket height).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Corner_Column: Cast-iron corner column (3 m) carrying the corner above a chamfered ground-floor entrance.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Counter_Shop: Shop counter 1.8 x 0.6 x 0.95 m: painted timber front panels, stone-slab top.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Crate_Fish: Stackable plastic fish crate (0.6 x 0.4 x 0.22 m) with hand holes; colour is a material slot.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Door_Balcony: Glazed double balcony door (balconera / ventanal) for the kit Door_Flat wall opening: two leaves with kick
panels and 2x3 panes. Replaces the kit's plank doors on upper floors. Kit MI_WoodTrim + MI_WindowGlass.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Door_Portal_Reformed: 1980s replacement portal door for the kit Door_Flat opening: bronze-anodised aluminium frame, wired glass,
push bar. Joinery slot is palette-remapped like painted timber.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Door_Service: Plain galvanised service door for the kit Door_Flat wall opening (1.3 m): reads as back-of-house, not public.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Downpipe: Rain-water downpipe, 3 m per unit height (the assembler scales y by storeys): painted iron pipe with socket
collars and wall brackets. Hopper head and shoe are separate modules so scaling never stretches them.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Downpipe_Head: Hopper head (embudo) under the eave: flared box collecting the gutter, short neck into the pipe. Pipe top at
y = 0; the hopper sits above it.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Downpipe_Shoe: Pipe shoe (zapata): the pipe kicks forward at the foot and ends in a cast-iron boot over the channel.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Drain_Grate: Cast-iron gutter grate set in the carriageway beside the kerb.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Eave_Canecillos: Lebaniego deep eave for one 2 m bay, fitted under the kit roof overhang: timber boarding (tablazón) following
the roof underside, five carved rafter tails (canecillos) and the wall plate. y = 0 is the facade top (floors x
3 m), the street face is at z = WALL_FACE. Kit MI_WoodTrim trim sheet (palette joinery: chestnut).

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Escudo: Generic casona shield (escudo) in sandstone, 0.7 x 1.0 m: moulded cartouche, heater-shaped field with a plain
cross-quartering, crest scroll on top and a corbel below. Heraldry-neutral: no real family arms.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Fence_Yard_2m: Controlled work-yard boundary, 2 m panel x 2.1 m: galvanised palisade on a low plinth. Distinct from the
public quay railing by height, material and permeability (you see through, you cannot pass).

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Fountain_Trough: Village fountain and trough (fuente-abrevadero): dressed stone pillar with a moulded cap and an iron spout, a
long stone trough with water, a step. Back against a wall at z = 0, facing +z.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Gallery_Bay: Glazed gallery bay (galería/mirador) for one 2 m bay and one storey, projecting 0.55 m: timber base panel,
3x3 glazing grid, cornice and a small lead-grey cap. Stacks storey on storey. Kit MI_WoodTrim + MI_WindowGlass.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Gate_Timber: Double-leaf plank gate (warehouse / yard) for the shop/gate opening; kit MI_WoodTrim planks + iron straps.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Gutter_Channel_2m: Central drainage channel for pedestrian streets: two sloped granite slabs forming a shallow V (0.6 m).

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Hill_Tree: Low-cost backdrop tree for the hills around the town: a conifer/oak blob of 2-3 solid painted lobes on a short
trunk, readable in silhouette through the valley fog.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Kerb_2m: Granite kerb 2 m x 0.28 m, top at +0.15 (pavement datum); kit MI_RockTrim slab band.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Kerb_Corner: Quarter-round kerb corner (radius 1 m) joining two ENV_Kerb_2m runs; kit MI_RockTrim slab band.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Kiosk_Plaza: Octagonal plaza kiosk (templete de música): stone base with two steps, eight slim cast-iron columns with
brackets, a frieze, a tiled octagonal roof with a finial. About 7 m across, 6 m high: a landmark for the river
plaza (the real plaza has one) without copying any real building.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Lamp_Post: Cast-iron street lamp in the classic Spanish 'fernandina' line (about 3.9 m): moulded base, fluted-looking
tapering shaft with collars, four-sided lantern with a pyramid hood and finial.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Lifebuoy_Post: Quay lifebuoy on a post with a small cabinet.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Manhole: Round cast-iron manhole cover flush with the paving.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Mooring_Line: Unit mooring rope along +z (1 m); the assembler stretches it from bollard to boat.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Net_Pile: Heap of fishing net with floats, about 1.4 m wide.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Pallet: Euro pallet 1.2 x 0.8 x 0.14 m; kit MI_WoodTrim dark plank band.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Parapet_2m: Low stone parapet (0.75 m) with granite coping — designed edge for overlooks and terraces.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Parapet_Rail_2m: Stone upstand (0.45 m) with a painted iron rail above it — the public waterfront edge treatment.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Parasol: Terrace parasol, 2.4 m canopy; canvas colour is a material slot (ENV_Canvas_Cream).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Phone_Booth: Late-1990s public phone cabin (generic, no branding): grey frame, glass sides, open front.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Planter_Pot: Terracotta planter pot (0.45 m): foot ring, flared body, rolled rim; soil top. Plants are placed separately.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Plinth_2m: Ashlar plinth band (zócalo) 2 m x 0.42 m standing 6 cm proud of the wall face: hides the wall/pavement seam
and ties ground floors of different buildings together. Kit MI_RockTrim ashlar band.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Plinth_Pier: Plinth stub for the pier beside a door/shop opening (0.2 m, scaled in x by the assembler).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Puddle_A: Irregular rain puddle (flat, glossy), about 1.6 x 1.1 m.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Puddle_B: Irregular rain puddle, about 1.0 x 0.7 m.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Quay_Ladder: Iron ladder fixed to the quay face (top at the coping, 3 m down).

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Quay_Steps: Stone steps running down the quay face to the water (1.6 m drop, 1.2 m wide), outer side wall.
Top step at y = 0 against the coping line (z = 0), descending towards +x.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Quay_Wall_4m: Public quay edge block 4 m long, 3.2 m face down to below water; rubble face + granite coping at y = 0.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Quoin_Ashlar: Ashlar quoins for one storey (3 m) of an exposed building corner: ten courses alternating long and short
blocks on the two faces, 3 cm proud of the render — slimmer than the kit pilaster the owner rejected. Local frame
as the kit corner piece: the outer corner is at (WALL_FACE, WALL_FACE), faces towards +x and +z.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Railing_Quay_2m: Public waterfront guard rail, 2 m, 1.05 m high: tube posts + three rails (painted iron).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Retaining_Wall_2x1: Retaining wall 2 m long, 1 m face, coping on top (upper datum at y = 0, lower street at -1).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Retaining_Wall_2x2: Retaining wall 2 m long, 2 m face, coping on top.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Retaining_Wall_2x3: Retaining wall 2 m long, 3 m face (one storey), coping on top.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_River_Stairs: Bajada al río: stone steps running down the face of the channel wall from the bank (y = 0) to a landing just
above the water (3 m lower), 1.3 m wide, with an iron handrail on the open side. Runs along +x; the wall face is
at z = 0 and the steps stand in front of it (+z, over the water).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Roof_Gable_4: Plain plaster gable for a 4 m span (roof ends above party walls and gable-fronted sheds).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Roof_Gable_6: Plain plaster gable for a 6 m span (roof ends above party walls and gable-fronted sheds).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Roof_Gable_8: Plain plaster gable for a 8 m span (roof ends above party walls and gable-fronted sheds).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Sat_Dish: Satellite dish on a wall bracket (late-1990s addition), facing +z and up.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Shop_Fascia: Painted fascia board over a shop opening in a moulded timber frame with end consoles (blank board).

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Shopfront_Door: Shop entrance for the shop opening: glazed door leaf (0.95 m) + side light, flush threshold (closed).
New geometry on the kit MI_WoodTrim trim sheet + MI_WindowGlass.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Shopfront_Door_Open: Same shop entrance with the leaf swung 88 degrees inwards: a walkable 0.9 m public threshold into a shallow
shop interior (the gameplay open/close interaction belongs to later GC2 work).

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Shopfront_Frame: Display window for the shop opening: painted timber frame, stall-riser panel, mullion, transom light.
New geometry on the kit MI_WoodTrim trim sheet + MI_WindowGlass (materials from Window_Wide_Flat1).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Shutter_Roller: Closed metal roller shutter (persiana) filling the shop opening: ribbed curtain, guide rails, housing box.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Sign_Bracket: Hanging shop sign on a wrought-iron bracket (the Pyrenean/lebaniego street's signature): wall plate, top bar,
a scrolled strut, two rings and a painted board in a moulded dark-timber frame (blank: no lettering in ENV).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Sign_Direction: Pedestrian direction post with two blank arrow plates (typography stays out of ENV).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Sign_NoEntry: Generic no-entry traffic sign on a galvanised post (disc facing +z).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Slipway: Concrete slipway ramp 4 m wide, 7 m long, dropping 1.8 m into the water (+z), stone kerbs.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Solana_Bay: Solana for one 2 m bay of the top floor (slot frame, y = 0 at the floor): board floor on carved joist tails,
front fascia, balustrade of turned balusters between rails, a post at the bay's left edge rising to the eave with
a zapata. Bays chain along the facade; ENV_Solana_Wing closes the ends. Kit MI_WoodTrim (palette joinery).

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Solana_Wing: Masonry wing wall (cortavientos) closing one end of a solana: 0.3 m thick, as deep as the solana, one storey,
in the building's wall material (MI_Plaster slot, palette remapped) with an ashlar coping. Slot frame at the
facade end; the wing projects along +z.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Street_Name_Plate: Wall-mounted ceramic street-name plate (blank; the street name is content, not ENV).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Trash_Bags: Three tied rubbish bags left by a door or bin.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Tree_Pit: Square iron tree-pit grate (alcorque) 1.3 m with a trunk hole.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Tree_Plaza: Plaza tree (plane/lime, pollarded): tapering trunk with bark (Nature pack bark), three limbs and a solid
painted crown of clustered lobes — no alpha cards (owner: card crowns read as big cards).
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_TV_Aerial: Rooftop TV aerial: 2.2 m mast with a Yagi boom and elements.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Utility_Box: Meter cabinet (hornacina de contadores) on a ground-floor facade: galvanised steel box with a recessed door,
hinges, lock, louvres and the service conduit down to the ground.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Vehicle_Car: Small 1990s hatchback (generic), 3.7 m, front towards +z. Body paint slot ENV_Paint_Red.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Vehicle_Van: Small 1990s delivery van (generic, no branding), 4.1 m, front towards +z. Body paint slot ENV_Paint_White.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Wall_Plaster_Clean: Plain plaster bay without half-timbering: keeps only the floor-line band.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Wall_Plaster_Clean_Base: Ground-floor plaster bay with the kit brick plinth kept, sill band/timber removed.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Wall_Plaster_Clean_Door: Plaster bay with the flat door opening (portals, balcony doors); side sill bands removed.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Wall_Plaster_Clean_DoorRound: Plaster bay with the arched door opening; timber removed.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Wall_Plaster_Clean_Thin: Plaster bay with the small round-head window; timber removed.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Wall_Plaster_Clean_Window: Plaster bay with the wide window opening; sill band removed, brick spandrel rendered over.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Wall_Plaster_Shopfront: Clean plaster ground-floor wall with a 1.6 x 2.38 m shop opening cut by boolean; reveals in kit stone trim.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Wall_UnevenBrick_Shopfront: Kit rubble-stone wall with the same shop/gate opening; reveals in kit stone trim.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Water_Plane_20m: Port water surface tile 20 x 20 m (y = 0 is the water level; place it below the quay coping).

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Window_Blind: Retro-fitted PVC roller blind (persiana enrollable) for the kit wide window: box over the head, slats
lowered two thirds — the typical 1970s–90s replacement over older joinery.
Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Window_Boarded: Boarded-up window for neglected buildings: rough planks across the kit wide window (MI_WoodTrim dark).

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Window_Insert_Thin: Glazed insert for the kit rubble-stone round-head window (±0.32 m, springing 2.31 m, crown 2.51 m):
rectangular sash plus a segmental glass head.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Window_Insert_Wide: Glazed joinery insert for the kit rubble-stone wide window opening (±0.60 x 1.05–2.31 m, measured on the
donor wall). The kit's `Window_Wide_Flat_Rocks` is only a stone surround; without this the building's empty
interior shows through. Recessed behind the surround: frame, mullion, transom, glass.

Blender recipe Tools/blender/env_derive.py::ENV_Window_Wide_Ashlar: Wide window for rendered walls in the casco manner: sandstone surround (jambs in alternating blocks, lintel
with ears, projecting sill) around the kit opening (±0.6, 1.05-2.31) and a recessed glazed sash. Replaces the
kit's white timber trim window where the grammar asks for ashlar surrounds.
